prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 13 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room, Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window.
Image 1: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S3
Image 3: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 4: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S2
Image 5: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 6: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 8: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 9: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 10: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 11: the prop pillow; use only structure, material, and color
Image 12: the prop agreement; use only structure, material, and color
Image 13: the prop Sebastian's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Natalie is inside the bedroom with her bag, behind the half-closed bedroom door on the back wall. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands at the kitchenette end of the couch. The white pillow lies at the front-door end of the couch; the signed agreement and the blue pen lie on the round coffee table.
Panel 1: Medium shot, eye-level, on Sebastian beside the couch, the half-closed bedroom door behind him. Sebastian pulls off his bow tie and tuxedo jacket and drops them over the couch arm.
Panel 2: Wide shot, high angle, from the kitchenette side over the dining table. Across the cut, Sebastian now wears a fitted white ribbed undershirt and black lounge trousers; he settles onto the couch at its kitchenette end and sets his black phone face down on the coffee table beside the agreement.
Panel 3: Medium shot, eye-level, on the bedroom door. The bedroom door opens and Natalie steps into the doorway, barefoot, in the powder-blue camisole and sleep shorts with the ivory robe hanging open.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, low angle, on Sebastian on the couch. Sebastian looks up from the couch toward the doorway, one arm along the couch back.
Panel 5: Medium shot, eye-level, on Natalie in the doorway, hand on the door frame. Natalie holds the door frame, her eyes fixed on him, nervous and determined.
Panel 6: Wide shot, eye-level, both in profile, following Sebastian from the couch to the bedroom door. Sebastian rises and walks to the bedroom door, stopping one step in front of Natalie.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie, slight high angle on Sebastian. Sebastian looks down at her, a quiet smile tugging at his mouth.
Panel 8: Close-up insert, eye-level, on their hands between them. Natalie reaches out and takes Sebastian's hand.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Sebastian, slight low angle on Natalie. Natalie holds his hand and lifts her eyes to his.
Panel 10: Medium shot, eye-level, both in profile in the bedroom doorway. Natalie rises onto her toes and kisses Sebastian.
Panel 11: Close-up, slow orbit around the couple's faces, staying on the kitchenette side. Sebastian kisses her back, his free hand settling at her waist over the robe.
Panel 12: Medium shot, eye-level, on Natalie, Sebastian's shoulder at the frame edge. Natalie steps back into the doorway and lets go of his hand, catching her breath.
Panel 13: Medium close-up, eye-level, dirty single on Sebastian with Natalie's shoulder at the frame edge. Sebastian lifts both hands slightly and gives a small nod.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
